ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low ratio of high-intensity pixels to low-intensity pixels. The visible surface is predominantly low-intensity (black) with sparse high-intensity (white) linear noise and water droplets.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity contiguous black region across both visible lobes. High-intensity pixel disruptions are present as thin, non-contiguous linear marks and a single circular ring on the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped depression visible at the water line; estimated pixel angle of approximately 40-50 degrees at the point of lobe convergence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency and high-amplitude irregular serrations (jagged peaks) extracted along the entire linear boundary of the trailing edge, ranging from 3 to 12 pixels in depth relative to the edge baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Asymmetrical concave curve; the right lobe exhibits a more acute upward and outward sweep compared to the left lobe, which presents a broader, more horizontal distal expansion.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed, high-contrast, multi-tonal (brown, white, and grey) textured pixel clusters localized at the extreme distal tips (lobes) of both flukes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-contrast, thin white linear streaks (rake marks) detected. Four prominent vertical lines on the right lobe and three fainter horizontal/diagonal lines on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation at the lateral tips creating significant irregular mass outside the primary fluke geometry; a distinct white circular annular scar is visible on the lower-medial quadrant of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The combination of extreme marginal serration and the specific white ring-shaped scar on the left lobe provides a unique spatial identifier.
